_about: Columns of replication/replications.csv, one row per reviewed hand-in (or one Rakiura reference row per condition). Public data only: rows from a lab's unpublished molecules never enter this file.

columns.name: row_id
columns.rule: assigned by update_table.py: R-0001, R-0002, ...; reference rows are REF-<dipeptide>-<acid>

columns.name: dipeptide
columns.rule: two-letter code, one of the 20 homodipeptides (AA, CC, ... YY)

columns.name: acid_code
columns.rule: K (98% w/w D2SO4) or H (81% w/w D2SO4)

columns.name: processing
columns.rule: pdata (instrument-processed) or raw (processed by the member)

columns.name: verdict
columns.rule: survives, degrades, side chain modified, or unsure

columns.name: matches_published
columns.rule: yes, no, or unsure (unsure where no published call exists)

columns.name: traps_flagged
columns.rule: how many trap checks fired in the member's run

columns.name: reviewed_on
columns.rule: YYYY-MM-DD, the day a reviewer approved the hand-in

columns.name: contributor
columns.rule: display name only with the member's opt-in; otherwise Rakiura member
